synopsis: A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love.

title: The Bourne Ultimatum
synopsis: Jason Bourne dodges a ruthless C.I.A. official and his Agents from a new assassination program while searching for the origins of his life as a trained killer.

title: The Bourne Identity
synopsis: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

title: Casino Royale
synopsis: After earning 00 status and a licence to kill, secret agent James Bond sets out on his first mission as 007.

title: Skyfall
synopsis: James Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt her. When MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat.

title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
synopsis: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team, along with some familiar allies, race against time after a mission gone wrong.

title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
synopsis: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team must track down a dangerous weapon before it falls into the wrong hands.

title: Avatar
synopsis: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
synopsis: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri.

title: Titanic
synopsis: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

title: The Social Network
synopsis: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea.

title: Moneyball
synopsis: Oakland A's general manager Billy Beane's successful attempt to assemble a baseball team on a lean budget by employing computer-generated analysis to acquire new players.

title: 12 Years a Slave
synopsis: In the antebellum United States, Solomon Northup, a free Black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery.

title: Spotlight
synopsis: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese.

title: Moonlight
synopsis: A young African-American man grapples with his identity and sexuality while experiencing the everyday struggles of childhood, adolescence, and burgeoning adulthood.

title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
synopsis: A mother personally challenges the local authorities to solve her daughter's murder when they fail to catch the culprit.

title: The Banshees of Inisherin
synopsis: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

title: The Holdovers
synopsis: A curmudgeonly instructor at a New England prep school is forced to remain on campus during Christmas break to babysit the handful of students with nowhere to go.

title: Poor Things
synopsis: An account of the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

title: Anatomy of a Fall
synopsis: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

title: Past Lives
synopsis: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrest apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Twenty years later, they are reunited for one fateful week.

title: Anora
synopsis: Anora, a young sex worker from Brooklyn, gets her chance at a Cinderella story when she meets and impulsively marries the son of an oligarch.

title: Twisters
synopsis: Kate Carter, a retired tornado-chaser and meteorologist, is persuaded to return to Oklahoma to work with a new team and new technologies.

title: The Fall Guy
synopsis: A down-and-out stuntman must find the missing star of his ex-girlfriend's blockbuster film.

title: Challengers
synopsis: Tashi, a former tennis prodigy turned coach, has transformed her husband into a champion. To overcome a losing streak, he needs to play against his former best friend.

title: The Substance
synopsis: A fading celebrity takes a black-market drug: a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.

title: Longlegs
synopsis: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.

title: Nosferatu
synopsis: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

title: Sinners
synopsis: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

title: Superman
synopsis: Follows the titular superhero as he reconciles his heritage with his human upbringing. He is the embodiment of truth, justice and a brighter tomorrow.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
synopsis: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family faces their most daunting challenge yet: Galactus.

title: Thunderbolts*
synopsis: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
synopsis: Our lives are the sum of our choices. Tom Cruise is Ethan Hunt in the epic conclusion to the Entity saga.

title: 28 Years Later
synopsis: A group of survivors of the rage virus lives on a small island. When one of the group leaves the island on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors.

title: Project Hail Mary
synopsis: An astronaut tries to save Earth while alone in outer space, forming an unexpected alliance along the way.

title: The Sixth Sense
synopsis: Malcolm Crowe, a child psychologist, starts treating a young boy, Cole, who acts as a medium to dead people, a role that causes him deep fright.

title: Trainspotting
synopsis: Renton, deeply immersed in the Edinburgh drug scene, tries to clean up and get out, despite the allure of the drugs and influence of friends.

title: Fargo
synopsis: Minnesota car salesman Jerry Lundegaard's inept crime falls apart due to his and his henchmen's bungling and the persistent police work of the quite pregnant Marge Gunderson.

title: The Game
synopsis: After a wealthy San Francisco banker is given an opportunity to participate in a mysterious game, his life is turned upside down as he begins to question if it might really be a concealed conspiracy.

title: Being John Malkovich
synopsis: A puppeteer discovers a portal that leads literally into the head of movie star John Malkovich.

title: Donnie Darko
synopsis: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
synopsis: After awakening from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
synopsis: The Bride continues her quest of vengeance against her former boss and lover Bill, the reclusive bouncer Budd and the treacherous, one-eyed Elle.

title: Oldboy
synopsis: After being kidnapped and imprisoned for fifteen years, Oh Dae-Su is released, only to find that he must find his captor in five days.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
synopsis: In the Falangist Spain of 1944, the bookish young stepdaughter of a sadistic army officer escapes into an eerie but captivating fantasy world.

title: The Lives of Others
synopsis: In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police, conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover, finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

title: 3 Idiots
synopsis: Two friends are searching for their long lost companion. They revisit their college days and recall the memories of their friend who inspired them to think differently.

title: Amelie
synopsis: Despite being caught in her imaginative world, Amelie, a young waitress, decides to help people find happiness. Her quest to spread joy leads her on a journey where she finds true love.

title: Taxi Driver
synopsis: A mentally unstable veteran works as a nighttime taxi driver in New York City, where the perceived decadence and sleaze fuels his urge for violent action.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
synopsis: King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table embark on a surreal, low-budget search for the Holy Grail, encountering many, very silly obstacles.

title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
synopsis: Born on the original Christmas in the stable next door to Jesus Christ, Brian of Nazareth spends his life being mistaken for a messiah.

title: Jaws
synopsis: When a killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Cape Cod, it's up to a local sheriff, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

title: A Clockwork Orange
synopsis: In the future, a sadistic gang leader is imprisoned and volunteers for a conduct-aversion experiment, but it doesn't go as planned.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
synopsis: After uncovering a mysterious artifact buried beneath the Lunar surface, a spacecraft is sent to Jupiter to find its origins—a spacecraft manned by two men and the supercomputer H.A.L. 9000.

title: Dr. Strangelove
synopsis: An unhinged American general orders a bombing attack on the Soviet Union, triggering a path to nuclear holocaust that a war room full of politicians and generals frantically tries to stop.

title: North by Northwest
synopsis: A New York City advertising executive goes on the run after being mistaken for a government agent by a group of foreign spies, and falls for a woman whose loyalties he begins to doubt.

title: Vertigo
synopsis: A former San Francisco police detective juggles wrestling with his personal demons and becoming obsessed with the hauntingly beautiful woman he has been hired to trail.

title: Sunset Boulevard
synopsis: A screenwriter develops a dangerous relationship with a faded film star determined to make a triumphant return.

title: Some Like It Hot
synopsis: After two male musicians witness a mob hit, they flee the state in an all-female band disguised as women, but further complications set in.

title: The Apartment
synopsis: A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but complications and a romance of his own ensue.

title: Citizen Kane
synopsis: Following the death of publishing tycoon Charles Foster Kane, reporters scramble to uncover the meaning of his final utterance: 'Rosebud.'
